assets.identity: a compact stack of bark-covered firewood logs with pale cut ends.
assets.subject: ONE neat pyramid stack of about nine round and split firewood logs, each about 1.1 m long and 15-25 cm thick, stacked in three rows (4, 3, 2), rough furrowed brown-grey bark with small moss patches, cut ends showing pale cream wood, concentric growth rings, radial cracks and axe chop facets, a couple of split logs showing their inner wood face. Total about 1.3 m wide, 1.0 m deep and 0.7 m tall, solid and stable.
assets.camera: front three-quarter view from the left, slightly above, showing the cut ends and one long side, entire stack uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Warm brown bark, pale yellow-cream cut ends.

assets.identity: one round bark-covered firewood log about 1.2 m long with two cut ends.
assets.subject: ONE single round firewood log lying horizontally, about 1.2 m long and 30 cm in diameter, deeply furrowed grey-brown bark with a few lichen and moss patches, a short cut-off branch stub, both ends cleanly chopped showing pale cream wood with concentric growth rings, radial drying cracks and axe facets. Straight solid cylinder-like log with natural irregularity.
assets.camera: three-quarter side view from slightly above showing the full length and one cut end, entire log uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Warm grey-brown bark, pale cream end grain.

assets.identity: a ring of rounded grey stones around charred crossed logs.
assets.subject: ONE prehistoric stone hearth about 1.6 m across and 0.5 m tall: a closed ring of eleven to thirteen rounded grey and brownish river stones of slightly different sizes, some soot-blackened on the inner side; inside, four charred split logs leaning together in a crossed teepee pile with black charcoal cracks and grey-white ash at the bottom, a few embers-dark chunks of charcoal. No flames, no smoke, no glow.
assets.camera: front three-quarter view from above at about 35 degrees down, showing the whole ring and the logs inside, uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Cool grey stones, black charred wood and pale ash.

assets.identity: two forked wooden posts with a crossbar and stretched hides hanging from it.
assets.subject: ONE prehistoric hide drying rack about 3 m wide and 2.4 m tall: two thick bark-stripped forked wooden posts, each braced by a leaning prop pole, a horizontal crossbar lashed in the forks with thick rawhide bindings; three stretched animal hides of different tan and brown tones hanging from the crossbar by short thick thongs, hides with irregular natural outlines, slight fur on edges, visible scraped inner side. All parts thick and solid, no thin long ropes.
assets.camera: front three-quarter view from the left at eye level, showing the full width, entire rack uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Pale weathered wood, tan and ochre hides.

assets.identity: a large rounded grey granite boulder with planar fractures.
assets.subject: ONE large weathered granite boulder about 2.2 m wide, 1.8 m deep and 1.7 m tall: massive rounded form with a few broad planar fracture faces and chipped edges, coarse speckled grey stone with warm ochre and rust staining, pale lichen rosettes and a little dark moss in the crevices and around the base, no plants growing on top.
assets.camera: front three-quarter view from slightly above, entire boulder uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Neutral warm grey granite with ochre staining.

assets.identity: a round leafy wild berry shrub with woody stems and small dark red berries.
assets.subject: ONE round wild berry shrub about 1.5 m wide and 1.2 m tall: woody grey-brown branches visible at the base fanning upward, dense clumps of small oval mid-green leaves grouped into clearly separated leafy masses with natural gaps, slightly lighter new leaves at the tips, a few small clusters of deep red berries on the outer leaves. Natural, not topiary.
assets.camera: front three-quarter view from slightly above, entire shrub including the base of the stems uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Mid-green leaves with warm highlights.

assets.identity: a rustic plank footbridge with simple pole handrails on both sides.
assets.subject: ONE rustic prehistoric footbridge about 7 m long and 1.6 m wide: two thick log stringers along the length, a deck of split half-log planks laid across them and lashed with rawhide, simple handrails of peeled poles on short upright posts on both sides lashed at every joint, slightly irregular plank widths, worn walking surface. Flat horizontal deck, straight bridge, no arch.
assets.camera: three-quarter view from the side and slightly above, showing the full length of the deck and both handrails, entire bridge uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Weathered grey-brown wood with darker lashings.

assets.identity: a single-log dugout canoe about 3.8 m long, hollowed out, blunt ends.
assets.subject: ONE prehistoric dugout canoe carved from a single large tree trunk, about 3.8 m long, 0.75 m wide and 0.5 m tall: hollowed interior showing adze and fire-hollowing marks, thick rounded hull walls, slightly upturned blunt bow and stern, some bark left along the outer gunwale line, warm brown wood grain. Empty, no paddle, no seats, no person.
assets.camera: three-quarter view from the side and above at about 30 degrees, showing the hollow interior and the outer hull, entire canoe uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Warm oak-brown wood with darker charred inner walls.

assets.identity: a large raw red meat chunk with white fat marbling.
assets.subject: ONE large raw chunk of mammoth meat about 30 cm long and 15 cm tall: deep red muscle with white fat marbling and a thick fat cap on one side, a cut end of a pale rib bone sticking out of one end, slightly irregular natural cut faces, moist but not glossy.
assets.camera: front three-quarter view from above at about 30 degrees, entire chunk uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Rich red meat, creamy white fat.

assets.identity: a knapped grey stone head lashed to a curved wooden handle.
assets.subject: ONE prehistoric hafted stone axe about 0.95 m long: a thick curved wooden handle with a natural knot and smoothed grip area wrapped with a band of rawhide near the bottom, a knapped grey-brown flint axe head with visible flake scars and a sharp edge, inserted into a split at the top of the handle and bound with thick crossed rawhide and sinew lashing. Axe standing upright, head at the top.
assets.camera: front three-quarter view, axe standing vertically, entire axe uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Warm brown wood, grey flint head.

assets.identity: a fire-hardened wooden spear with a sharpened tip.
assets.subject: ONE fire-hardened wooden hunting spear about 1.6 m long and 3 cm thick: straight peeled shaft with slight natural irregularity, a rawhide grip wrap in the lower middle, the top 20 cm carved to a sharp point and darkened by fire hardening. Spear standing perfectly vertical, point at the top.
assets.camera: straight front view, spear vertical and centered, entire spear uncropped with generous margin.
variants: Pale ash-wood shaft, charred dark tip.

assets.identity: a wooden spear shaft tipped with a black obsidian blade bound with sinew.
assets.subject: ONE prehistoric obsidian-tipped spear about 2.1 m long: straight wooden shaft about 3 cm thick with a rawhide grip wrap in the lower middle, a glossy black obsidian leaf-shaped blade about 18 cm long with conchoidal flake scars and razor edges, hafted into a split shaft end and bound with tan sinew lashing and dark pine-pitch glue. Spear standing perfectly vertical, blade at the top.
assets.camera: straight front view, spear vertical and centered, entire spear uncropped with generous margin.
variants: Warm brown shaft, jet-black obsidian blade with faint smoky translucency at the edges.

assets.identity: a single knapped black obsidian blade.
assets.subject: ONE loose knapped obsidian blade about 29 cm long, leaf-shaped, thick in the middle and thin at the edges, glossy black with smoky grey translucency at the thin edges, clear conchoidal flake scars over both faces, a slightly thicker unworked base. Lying flat.
assets.camera: three-quarter view from above at about 40 degrees, entire blade uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Jet-black obsidian.

assets.identity: a slender curved single-edged sword with a dark wrapped handle and small round guard.
assets.subject: ONE slender katana-style curved single-edged sword about 1.05 m long: polished steel blade with a subtle wavy temper line and gentle curve, a small round dark iron guard, a handle wrapped in dark navy cord over pale ray skin, a simple dark pommel cap. Sword standing vertical, tip at the top.
assets.camera: straight front view of the flat of the blade, sword vertical and centered, entire sword uncropped with generous margin.
variants: Bright steel, navy handle wrap.

assets.identity: a single ribbed cream-brown cockle shell.
assets.subject: ONE single empty cockle shell valve about 10 cm wide: strong radial ribs with fine growth lines, cream to pale tan with warm brown concentric bands, rounded heart-like outline, slightly glossy inside. Lying with the convex outer side up.
assets.camera: three-quarter view from above at about 45 degrees, entire shell uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Cream and warm brown banding.

assets.identity: a low heap of discarded shells.
assets.subject: ONE low prehistoric shell midden heap about 1.2 m across and 0.4 m tall: hundreds of discarded cockle, mussel and limpet shells piled in a rounded mound, mixed with grey ash, dark soil and a few charcoal bits, shells of varied sizes clearly readable on the surface.
assets.camera: front three-quarter view from above at about 35 degrees, entire heap uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Cream and grey-blue shells with dark soil.

assets.identity: a tall columnar cactus with upturned arms.
assets.subject: ONE tall columnar cactus about 2.4 m tall: a thick ribbed main trunk with three curved arms turning upward at different heights, deep vertical ribs with rows of small pale spine clusters, sage green with dustier yellow-green near the base and a slightly woody base, no flowers.
assets.camera: front three-quarter view at eye level, entire cactus uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Sage green with dusty yellowed base.

assets.identity: a cluster of jagged blue-white glacier ice spires on a snowy base.
assets.subject: ONE cluster of jagged glacier ice spires about 13 m tall and 15 m wide: four to six tall faceted ice blades leaning at different angles from a broken ice mound, translucent blue-cyan ice with white snow caps on the ledges, sharp fracture planes, deeper blue in the crevices, no internal glow.
assets.camera: front three-quarter view from slightly below eye level, entire cluster uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Cool turquoise ice with bright snow.

assets.identity: a low dark volcanic cone with a crater and red lava cracks.
assets.subject: ONE small volcanic cinder cone about 24 m tall and 70 m wide: broad concave slopes of dark grey-black basalt rubble and ash, a wide crater at the top with a jagged rim, a few thin orange-red cooling lava cracks running down the upper slope, rough rocky texture. No smoke, no eruption.
assets.camera: front three-quarter view from slightly above, entire cone uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Charcoal basalt with dull orange cracks.

assets.identity: a cluster of dark hexagonal basalt columns of different heights.
assets.subject: ONE cluster of columnar basalt about 4.6 m tall: tightly packed dark grey hexagonal and pentagonal stone columns of stepped different heights, flat broken tops, horizontal fracture joints along each column, a few fallen column pieces at the foot, slight rust-brown weathering.
assets.camera: front three-quarter view at eye level, entire cluster uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Dark charcoal basalt with rust weathering.

assets.identity: a tall conifer tree about 10 m with a straight trunk and layered crown.
assets.subject: ONE tall Ice Age Scots pine about 10 m tall: straight reddish-orange flaking upper trunk and grey furrowed lower bark, a crown made of several clearly separated, broad, smooth-silhouetted layered branch tiers of dark blue-green needles grouped into soft clumps (painterly, not grainy, no individual needle noise), visible branch arms between tiers, slightly irregular natural asymmetry, bare trunk for the lower third.
assets.camera: front view at mid-height, entire tree uncropped from root flare to tip with generous margin, centered.
variants: Dark blue-green clumps, warm orange upper trunk.
Deep green clumps with lighter sunlit tips, grey-orange trunk.

assets.identity: a clump of long smooth meadow grass blades with no soil base.
assets.subject: ONE natural clump of wild meadow grass about 0.55 m tall: about ten to fourteen broad smooth flat blades arching outward from a single narrow base point, blades of different lengths with gently bent tips, mid-green with lighter yellow-green tips and darker base, no flowers, no soil mound, no pot, no visible ground.
assets.camera: front three-quarter view slightly above, entire clump uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Fresh mid-green with yellow-green tips.

assets.identity: one or two single grass blades.
assets.subject: ONE tiny sprig of wild grass about 0.45 m tall: just two broad smooth blades arching apart from one narrow base point, one longer and one shorter, mid-green with lighter tips, no soil mound, no visible ground.
assets.camera: front three-quarter view slightly above, entire sprig uncropped with generous margin, centered.
variants: Fresh mid-green with yellow-green tips.
